clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as cel-shaded concept art moodboard, high-contrast teal-and-orange, oiled walnut

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as cel-shaded'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Lighting reference: flickering firelight as the only motivated source.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as cel-shaded'.
